name: Selpercatinib for RET-Mutant Medullary Thyroid Carcinoma
cyclesNote: continuous until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity; not a fixed cycle count

source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.RET: pathogenic variant present (germline or somatic RET mutation)
biomarkers.note: This regimen is biomarker-gated to a RET pathogenic variant (germline RET in hereditary MTC/MEN2, or somatic RET in sporadic MTC). Selpercatinib is a selective RET inhibitor and is a category 1 preferred option specifically for RET-mutant disease; RET-independent multikinase inhibitors (cabozantinib, vandetanib) are the category 1 options when RET status does not direct a selective inhibitor. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Thyroid Carcinoma v2.2026, Medullary Carcinoma (MEDU).

histology: medullary thyroid carcinoma (calcitonin-producing parafollicular C-cell carcinoma)
supportiveCare: blood-pressure control: hypertension is common with selpercatinib; monitor and treat.
monitor for hepatotoxicity (ALT/AST), QT prolongation, hemorrhage, and hypersensitivity per labeling.
monitor calcitonin and carcinoembryonic antigen (CEA) as MTC tumor markers for response.
avoid abrupt discontinuation without taper per labeling if on prolonged therapy.
monitoring: ECG for QT prolongation and electrolytes (potassium, magnesium)

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 3 to 4 hepatotoxicity, QT prolongation, or hypertension
doseModificationRules.text: Interrupt for grade 3 to 4 or intolerable toxicity; resume at a reduced dose per labeling once recovered; obtain clinical review.

drugs.name: Selpercatinib
drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., line 70618. Selpercatinib 160 mg PO TWICE DAILY (represented here as continuous daily dosing; twice-daily frequency is source-stated) for patients at or above 50 kg. DeVita line 70618 states selpercatinib's uniform registered recommended dose (160 mg twice per day) in the NSCLC RET chapter; this is the drug's single, tumor-type-agnostic registered dose, not an MTC-specific citation. The medullary thyroid indication and the same 160 mg twice-daily dose are grounded for MTC by Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Thyroid Carcinoma v2.2026: Medullary Carcinoma selpercatinib category 1 for RET PV positive (MEDU-4, thyroid.txt line 3123) and the phase 3 LIBRETTO-531 first-line RET-mutant MTC trial (thyroid.txt line 3288 reference; Discussion line 5515 to 5517). The 160 mg twice-daily dose is clinically correct for RET-mutant MTC and is retained (not VERIFY). Given continuously until progression or unacceptable toxicity.
